# Rave Wellness

> Evidence-based harm reduction for the rave and festival community. Drug safety guides, interaction information, and peer-reviewed research written for people who have decided to participate — not to lecture them.

## About

Rave Wellness publishes harm reduction information grounded in clinical pharmacology and peer-reviewed research. All guides cite primary sources (PubMed PMIDs) and clearly distinguish between human evidence, animal data, and community consensus.

## Drug Guides

- https://www.ravewellness.org/mdma.html — MDMA harm reduction: dosing, interactions, supplements, serotonin syndrome, the 3-month rule
- https://www.ravewellness.org/ketamine.html — Ketamine: bladder damage, addiction risk, k-holes, dissociation
- https://www.ravewellness.org/lsd.html — LSD: duration, testing for NBOMes, set and setting, interactions
- https://www.ravewellness.org/psilocybin.html — Psilocybin: clinical evidence, dosing, bad trips, clinical trials
- https://www.ravewellness.org/cocaine.html — Cocaine: cardiovascular risk, adulterants, levamisole, fentanyl testing
- https://www.ravewellness.org/ghb.html — GHB/GBL: narrow therapeutic window, overdose signs, alcohol interaction
- https://www.ravewellness.org/poppers.html — Poppers: alkyl nitrites, PDE5 inhibitor interaction, cardiac risk
- https://www.ravewellness.org/2cb.html — 2C-B: effects, dosing, difference from tusi/pink cocaine
- https://www.ravewellness.org/nitrous.html — Nitrous oxide: B12 depletion, nerve damage, spinal cord risk
- https://www.ravewellness.org/hearing.html — Hearing health: tinnitus, noise-induced hearing loss, earplug guide

## Tools

- https://www.ravewellness.org/interactions.html — Drug interaction checker
- https://www.ravewellness.org/test-kits.html — Drug testing guide (reagent kits, fentanyl strips)

## Blog

- https://www.ravewellness.org/blog.html — All articles
- https://www.ravewellness.org/rss.xml — RSS feed

## Key Topics Covered

MDMA neurotoxicity, serotonin syndrome, MDMA supplements protocol (5-HTP, ALA, magnesium), candy flipping, hippie flipping, fentanyl test strips, naloxone use, GHB overdose, ketamine bladder damage, psychedelic harm reduction, festival safety, drug checking, DanceSafe, MAPS clinical trials.

## Editorial Standards

All clinical claims cite PubMed-indexed research with PMID links. Evidence is tiered (RCTs and systematic reviews weighted above case reports and animal data). Methodological limitations are disclosed. No content endorses or encourages illegal activity.
